title: Learning to Learn with Contrastive Meta-Objective

predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The text and Algorithm 2 repeatedly refer to 'equation (1)' for the inner-task distance d_τ^in, but no such equation is defined in the paper. This missing definition makes the method description incomplete and unreproducible.

predicted_errors.error_location: Section 3.1, paragraph beginning 'The subsets κ_k used to compute d_τ^in...'
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The text contains an unfinished editorial note: 'However, π_κ is not rigorously defined, leaving unclear how subset sizes, overlap, and sampling bias are controlled. Further specification and justification of π_κ choices are necessary to ensure meaningful alignment measurement and reproducibility of the method.' This note indicates that a critical component of the method is not properly specified, making the paper effectively incomplete.

predicted_errors.error_location: Appendix B (Proof of Theorem 1 and Lemma 1)
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The proof attempts to show that minimizing L_c makes the model output distribution symmetric, which then minimizes an upper bound on excess risk. The derivation contains unjustified steps: (i) the MLP approximation is forced into a restricted form (sum of σ(⟨w_k, X_g⟩) without output weights or biases) with no justification; (ii) it claims that the inner-task and inter-task cosine similarity conditions imply symmetry of the distribution (P(X)=P(-X)), which does not follow in general. The claimed theorem is therefore unsupported.
